newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aisin Seiki denies report of new European factory.
newsitem.headline: Aisin Seiki denies report of new European factory.

text.p: Aisin Seiki Co Ltd on Tuesday denied a newspaper report that it plans to spend 10 billion yen to build an auto parts factory in Europe as early as 2000.
"We have no such plans," said a company spokesman.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily said on Tuesday that the company plans to build its first European factory to supply engine parts and other auto parts to Toyota Motor Corp's second European factory, planned for as early as 2000.
The Aisin spokesman said, however, that the company plans to dispatch a team later this month to study the European market.
